ID: validation_worker Responsibility: Run committed validation manifests against an exact revision. Owner: Operator-managed worker Runtime: Node.js and repository tools State variables: validation_id; revision; decision Invariants: Validation is bound to the assessed commit and manifest. ID: git_spice Responsibility: Represent stacked branches and change-request relationships. Owner: Operator-managed tool Runtime: git-spice executable State variables: branch; parent; children; head_sha Invariants: Stack snapshots are tied to the current repository state. ID: github Responsibility: Store ordinary code and provide the pull-request review surface. Owner: GitHub Runtime: Hosted Git service State variables: pr_number; head_sha; checks; reviews Invariants: Code and review identity use repository and head identifiers. ID: review_command Responsibility: Import GitHub and agent feedback, retain triage, and evaluate readiness. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js State variables: review_id; pr_number; head_sha; readiness Invariants: Stale feedback remains visible and cannot authorize a new head. text.tspan: Start run / task payload or CLI arguments
Resolve checkpoint metadata / Entire CLI JSON
Read or execute stack operation / git-spice CLI JSON
Read PR and review state / GitHub REST API
